exemptions.authority: Login, logout, getSession, own approval status and self-service re-authentication use authenticated subject ownership.
Enrollment, renewal, ACME and SCEP use channel-specific principals, token or account bindings and jobs authorization; administrative issuance and approval still require their catalogue entries.
Ordinary ingest, correlation, export, hold capture and retention workers use their narrow service authority. Operator promotion, replay, backfill and hold changes require the named permissions.
First-start setup and sealed offline custodian recovery use one-time setup or quorum authority, never a console permission.
Local installation or repair with a signed OS package, direct OS removal and user warn dialogs use local OS or endpoint authority; they do not grant console access.

Host-provided MaxMind files, ingest partition caps, database durability and storage configuration require deployment authority. No platform.settings permission grants host, database or cloud administration.

Excluding compromised hosts, revoking external credentials and gateway-side secret cutover require the relevant host, CA or gateway authority. Ricevanta registration writes and certificate issuance retain their catalogue checks.
Apple portal renewal and vendor CSR signing require the external account or signing key. Ricevanta CSR creation, certificate upload and topic replacement retain separate permissions.
Lab execution, retained qualification evidence and independent reviewer decisions are development/release activities, not console administration permissions.
Compiled policy actions, inventory changes and directory sync use their constrained protocol authority; manual writes, governed-pack re-enable and approvals retain catalogue requirements.

An external CA performs its own issuance or revocation under its authority. Ricevanta reconciliation uses pki.external_issuance.reconcile and device or infrastructure certificate revocation keeps its separate immediate permission.
